summary: An Ickenham aesthetics clinic appears to lose bookings to a homepage that still says the clinic is closed for Covid until July 2020.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to still say WE ARE CURRENTLY CLOSED due to Covid-19 and that the clinic aims to open on 4th July 2020.
findings.cost: A visitor who reads this assumes the clinic is shut and books somewhere else, so you lose enquiries every day the notice stays up.
findings.fix: A current page that says you are open and how to book.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner and a footer that says 2020 by Estetica London Aesthetics.
findings.cost: A free builder address and an old date look temporary for a clinic that offers anti wrinkle injections.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a current page.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a gmail address and a mobile number, with no WhatsApp and no online booking.
findings.cost: Clients book aesthetic treatments by message, and the clinic that replies first wins the booking.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and online booking.
